pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ denti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.6: “Ime, āvuso, chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā amhākaṃ pahāraṃ dentī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.7: Ye te bhikkhū appicchā…pe… te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti—
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.8: “kathañhi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ dassantī”ti…pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.9: “saccaṃ kira tumhe, bhikkhave, kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ dethā”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.12: kathañhi nāma tumhe, moghapurisā, kupitā anattamanā bhikkhūnaṃ pahāraṃ dassatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.14: evañca pana, bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha—
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:1.15.1: “Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ dadeyya, pācittiyan” ti. ( 74 : 123 )
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.1.10: kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattenapi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.1: Upasampanne upasampannasaññī kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.2: Upasampanne vematiko kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.3: Upasampanne anupasampannasaññī kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc74:2.2.4: Anupasampannassa kupito anattamano pahāraṃ deti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
